content.title: About Vitaheal
content.body:
Made in Sweden, for every day

Vitaheal makes a small range of supplements for sleep, focus, hydration and healthy ageing. Each product does one job, and we only keep the ingredients that earn their place.

How we work

  • Everything is blended and packed in Sweden.
  • Every batch is tested before it ships.
  • Refills come in bags, so one can lasts for years.

Most customers subscribe, which saves 20% on every delivery. You can skip, pause or cancel at any time.
content.seoDescription: Vitaheal makes a small range of supplements in Sweden for sleep, focus, hydration and healthy ageing.

content.title: Money-back guarantee terms
content.body:
30 days to try Unwind

If Unwind is not right for you, tell us within 30 days of delivery and we will refund your first can or bag.

What the guarantee covers

  • Your first order of Unwind, in either format.
  • One refund per customer and household.

What it does not cover

  • Other Vitaheal products.
  • Shipping costs for orders outside Sweden.

Other returns follow our refund policy.
content.seoDescription: The 30-day money-back guarantee for Unwind: what it covers and how to claim it.

content.body:
How we use cookies

We use a small number of cookies. Some are needed for the store to work, such as the one that remembers your cart. Others help us understand how the store is used, and we only set those with your consent.

Your choices

You can change your mind at any time from the cookie settings link in the footer.
content.seoDescription: Which cookies the Vitaheal store sets and how to change your choices.

content.body:
Refund policy

You can return unopened products within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. Write to us first and we will send a return label.

Subscriptions

You can cancel a subscription before its next charge date. A delivery that has already been charged can be returned under the same 14-day rule.

Unwind also has a 30-day money-back guarantee.
content.seoDescription: How returns and refunds work at Vitaheal.

We collect the details we need to deliver your order and look after your subscription: your name, address, email and order history. Your card details go straight to our payment provider and never reach us.

Your rights

content.title: Three habits for better sleep
content.body:
Good sleep starts hours before bed. These three habits cost nothing and work for most people.

1. Keep one wake-up time

Getting up at the same time every day, weekends included, does more for your sleep than an early night.

2. Dim the lights after dinner

Bright light tells your body it is still daytime. Lower lamps and a darker screen help it wind down.

3. Give yourself an hour

Stop work, put the phone in another room, and do something slow for the last hour of the day.
content.seoTitle: Three habits for better sleep | Vitaheal
content.seoDescription: Three simple evening habits that make it easier to fall asleep.

content.title: How much water do you need when you train?
content.body:
There is no single number. How much you need depends on how long you train, how hard, and how warm it is.

A simple check

Weigh yourself before and after a session. Each kilo you lose is about a litre of sweat to replace over the next few hours.

Why salt matters

Sweat carries sodium out with it. On long or hot sessions, water with electrolytes replaces what plain water cannot.
content.seoTitle: How much water do you need when you train? | Vitaheal
content.seoDescription: A practical way to work out how much to drink around training.

content.title: Why we sell refills
content.body:
A can is the best way to store a powder: it keeps out light, air and moisture. It is also the heaviest part of the parcel.

So we sell each product once in a can, and after that in a bag. A refill uses far less packaging, costs a little less, and fits through more letterboxes.

If you subscribe, your first delivery is a can and the ones after it are refills.
content.seoDescription: Why Vitaheal sells each product once in a can and then in refill bags.
